rows.summary: Indian Railways will extend travel insurance options to passengers booking unreserved and reserved tickets at physical counters starting October 27. The bench initiated these proceedings regarding railway safety following the June 2023 Odisha train accident. Passengers will now be able to secure coverage similar to online ticket bookings.

rows.why_it_matters: Counter ticket holders gain accident coverage options

rows.headline: How a one-year job loss impacts your mutual fund SIP wealth target
rows.hook: Job loss changes your long-term wealth goals
rows.summary: Systematic Investment Plans in mutual funds are a widely used method for Indian retail investors to gain exposure to the stock market. rows.headline: India halves diesel export tax while raising gasoline levy
rows.hook: Fortnightly tax shift on fuel exports
rows.summary: India has reduced its diesel export duty by nearly half for the next two weeks while increasing the gasoline export levy fivefold, effective October 16. The policy adjustment aims to balance domestic availability against global market shortages and price volatility. India reviews these export duties fortnightly based on prevailing domestic and international conditions. Refiners must now adjust export volumes to align with the revised tax structure.
